name: Dwarf_Guardian_Hall_Hex_V1
origin: center of footprint on ground Z=0
scale: Native 4X map units; pointy-top tile radius 1, military foundation radius .92; placement scale tile_radius. Asset only, no integration.
design: Original dwarf tank hall: squat heavy granite barracks, monumental rune-inlaid stone portal, dark slate stepped vault with thick copper bindings and large angular copper-rimmed steel shield with clan-blue inset. Compact attached stone bastion with square merlons, copper belts and blue shield standard. Open wedge drill yard with two short shield-practice straw dummies in steel helmet caps, stance markers and two reserve shields on a rack. Palette matches dwarf city I. Same shared shieldbearer/guardian/sentinel training line; supreme guardian belongs to separate mastery building. No surrounding wall ring or character-model dependency.
notes: Studio and scale reference excluded from export. Separate editable source parts; consolidated game meshes by architectural group.
faction_tint: Blue shield insets and bastion standard isolated in Faction mesh for future owner tint; slate, granite, copper and steel retain their palette. No runtime integration.
